text:
maria: Heads-up — got two customers saying their NDJSON export is missing chunks. manifest shows 12 chunks, download contained 8. happens across tenants, not just one.

sam: Do you have a manifest/id we can look at? any logs?

maria: manifest id `mf-2026-03-20-09` — logs show a bunch of `DroppedMessageQuota` from export-queue yesterday around 09:14. snippet:
```
export-service: enq export=mf-2026-03-20-09 chunks=12
queue: accept -> queued_at=1710000000
queue: drop event_id=evt-xx reason=DroppedMessageQuota target=export-topic-3
```

ops-bot: ALARM: export-queue-delay > 30s for topic=export-topic-3 (avg=48s) :warning:

lee: If the console marks an export as "done" but it's actually missing chunks, that's a UX/legal problem. we should show delivery receipts and a chunk count somewhere.

irina: From compliance side — missing who/when entries is high risk. legal asked we immediately surface anything partial as "incomplete" and flag to SOC.

sam: Root telemetry we need: `export.request.chunks_expected`, `export.chunks.delivered`, `export.chunks.failed`, `export.topic.queue_evictions`. we'll also want a delta histogram so we can alert when delivered < expected.

jun: quick hunch: routing policy change from yesterday demoted export-topic to background class on some hosts. low-priority routes have `quota.eviction_policy=oldest` and small window; under spike exports got evicted rather than backpressured. config excerpt:
```yaml
routing.policies:
  export-topic-3:
    priority: background
    quota: 50000
    eviction_policy: oldest
```

maria: that matches timeline — we bumped background quotas for inference bursts yesterday. can we rollback that routing change for compliance topics?

sam: short-term mitigation: bump queue size + make eviction policy "block" for topics with label `compliance:true`. longer-term: add export-health telemetry and a per-export checksum/manifest that the console can verify. also add a delivery-receipt webhook so customers can get ack counts.

lee: UX requests: show a small badge next to exports: `complete | partial | failed`. tooltip should show `expected 12 chunks • delivered 8 • reason: DroppedMessageQuota` and a CTA "request re-export". keep it unobtrusive but obvious.

irina: Legal also wants an automated ticket to SOC when any export is `partial` and to include tenant id + manifest + sample missing keys.

jun: i'll take infra change (routing rollback & non-evicting for compliance). estimate 2-3 hrs + rollout.
maria: i'll own the service patch to emit `chunks_expected`/`chunks_delivered` and mark export state = `incomplete` when mismatch. i'll open PR this afternoon.
sam: i'll add dashboards/alerts: per-tenant export loss rate + an alert when any export shows delivered/expected < 0.95. will also wire the webhook ack endpoint.

lee: i'll prototype the console badge + tooltip. can we add the `request re-export` button that calls a new POST `/api/exports/:id/retry`?
maria: yes, API endpoint makes sense — we'll validate and trigger reassembly from raw ledger.

irina: thanks all. timeline request from legal: SOC alerts enabled within 24h. is that doable?
jun: can do the routing rollback now, push within 1h. that should stop new evictions.
sam: dashboards+alerts in ~4h, webhook in ~6h.
maria: service patch PR shortly, will include a migration to mark past suspect exports as `incomplete` if chunks_delivered < chunks_expected.

lee: ok triage: jun infra rollback (now) -> maria service patch (this afternoon) -> sam dashboards/webhook (today) -> lee UI (tomorrow). assign and track in GH.
jun: @oncall FYI, i'm doing a config change, will post deploy notes.
maria: tagging the customers affected and sending tentative rollback plan; will follow up with PR link and runbook. :thumbsup:

sam: thanks — big win if we can make export health first-class. small ask: add synthetic check that downloads and verifies manifests hourly so we detect regressions earlier.
maria: agree — adding synthetic verifier to the telemetry backlog.

ops-bot: NOTE: deploy started by jun to routing-config (change-id rc-999).

lee: i'll create the console ticket and prototype screenshots.

maria: closing loop here — will post PR + runbook when ready. anyone else?

jun: will post rollback logs when done.

sam: ack, monitoring.

irina: filing SOC alert playbook now.

maria: thanks all.
